about.title: Ruitao Lin
about.subtitle: Senior Frontend / Full Stack Engineer
about.summaryText: 9+ years of frontend development experience, involved in the full lifecycle of WeChat H5, Web admin systems, and mini-program projects. Led a team of 5 frontend engineers, capable of independently architecting projects and establishing frontend development standards. Proficient in Vue 2/3 ecosystem, with React.js and Angular.js experience. Backend development skills with Node.js (Nest.js), and basic Java/Spring Boot knowledge.
about.educationDegree: South China University of Technology - Computer Science (Bachelor)
about.educationDiploma: Guangdong Vocational College of Science and Technology - Software Technology (Associate)

highlights: Led technical architecture design and development of FRP warehouse management system and mobile H5 projects using Vue3 + TypeScript + Vite + Pinia
Established frontend engineering infrastructure: GitLab CI + Jenkins automated deployment, ESLint + Prettier + Husky standards
Managed outsourced resources and requirement decomposition, coordinated with product, backend, and QA teams to ensure delivery quality
Led the full migration of legacy Angular.js admin system to Vue3, participated in code review, improved technical documentation and component standards
Managed requirements coordination and remote development for spot grid trading H5 project, ensuring smooth delivery
Participated in the development and maintenance of Huobi Futures MGT admin system modules
Led a 5-person frontend team to build 'Youshu Mall' mini-program (UniApp) from scratch, responsible for tech selection and core module architecture
Independently completed community mini-program refactoring and emergency release during COVID, received quarterly 'Tech Star' award
Independently built and delivered Kema Micro Steward (Private Domain) CRM project
Developed WeChat Official Account H5 projects and admin systems using Vue2, independently designed and delivered multiple modules
Participated in OCR intelligent recognition AI projects, extracting structured data from images

project1.name: SonarDApp

project2.name: FRP Warehouse Management System

project3.name: Huobi GMT Admin System
project3.description: Developed core modules including asset approval, risk control tools, and financial management. Optimized frontend performance through lazy loading and on-demand loading strategies.

project4.name: Kema Youshu Mall Mini-Program
project4.description: Responsible for tech selection and frontend architecture design. Led migration from H5 to UniApp mini-program, resolved performance bottlenecks improving page load speed by ~20%.
